text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Good day, Trainer! What a beautiful morning! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I had the most wonderful dream last night! There was a big parade and everyone was in it, even the fairies!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There were banshees, the Dullahan… Oh, and púcaí as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I quickly pull up information on the fairies she mentioned… but I can't help thinking all the results look incredibly creepy. Maybe it's just me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Perhaps they'll come out to play again soon. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel somewhat unsettled, but at least Fine Motion seems to have gotten some good rest.
